experimentContext: Repeat the same basket in the user's normal channel context to measure short-term quote stability without placing an order.
tipPolicy: Set optional pickup tips to $0 before recording a final checkout total.
comparisonStatus: About 91 minutes after the first capture, both channel totals and the $0.69 Uber Eats advantage were unchanged. The repeat quotes were captured within two seconds and immediately rechecked.
limitations: This is a same-night repeat for one basket at one restaurant; it does not establish multi-day stability.
A stale two-item direct cart was detected and cleared before this run, demonstrating that every capture must verify an empty starting cart.
The direct checkout was anonymous and Uber Eats was signed in because those were the user's normal available paths; account context is recorded per observation.
